summary: Mobile port backend testing complete. 13/13 tests PASSED (100%) covering all endpoints in the review request: register/login/me, chat with structured_recipes, recipes save+list, weekly-plan current+generate, shopping-list, AI recipe image (Gemini Nano Banana) generation + PNG fetch, and Apple Sign In invalid-token 401 path. All flows work end-to-end against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/register -> 200 with access_token + user (fresh TEST_ account)
POST /api/auth/login (valid) -> 200 with access_token + user matching email
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer -> 200 returning correct user id/email
POST /api/chat/send with [User Preferences] message + session_id -> 200 with response + structured_recipes list (4 items each having title/description/cuisine)
POST /api/weekly-plan/generate {mood: happy, dietary_preference: vegetarian} -> 200 with plan/days structure
POST /api/recipe-image/ai-generate (Gemini Nano Banana) -> 200 {url: /api/recipe-image/img/<hash>.png}; GET url -> 200 image/png > 500 bytes

api_contract_notes.POST /api/chat/send: Requires body { session_id: str, message: str } (session_id is mandatory). Returns { session_id, response, timestamp, structured_recipes }.
api_contract_notes.POST /api/recipes/save: Requires { recipe: RecipeCreate } where RecipeCreate needs title, description, ingredients, instructions, mood_tags, prep_time, cook_time, complexity, nutritional_highlights. Cuisine goes under 'cuisine_type', not 'cuisine'. Mobile app should map structured_recipes fields accordingly before saving.
api_contract_notes.POST /api/recipe-image/ai-generate: Returns { url, cached }. url is relative under /api/recipe-image/img/<md5>.png; caching by md5(title|cuisine) works (subsequent calls return cached=true instantly).

action_items: Mobile client: when saving a recipe from chat structured_recipes, ensure it fills the required Recipe fields (mood_tags, prep_time, cook_time, complexity, nutritional_highlights) and uses 'cuisine_type' (not 'cuisine') — otherwise /api/recipes/save returns 422.
Mobile client: /api/chat/send requires a 'session_id' string in the body along with 'message' — send a persistent per-conversation id.
Mobile client: parse GET /api/recipes/saved as { recipes: [...] } object shape.
critical_code_review_comments: gen_image.py: correctly serves images under /api/recipe-image/img/ so ingress routes them; md5 cache prevents duplicate Gemini calls; graceful 500 on failure.

apple_auth.py: verifies against Apple JWKS with configured APPLE_AUDIENCES (bundle id + host.exp.Exponent); invalid token path correctly returns 401. Users upserted into same users collection with hard entitlement defaults — /auth/me works uniformly for email and Apple users.
auth.py register: hard-sets plan=free/subscription_status=inactive/trial defaults and auto-starts 7-day trial via auto_start_trial_if_eligible — consistent with entitlement rules.
server.py: all new routers (gen_image, apple_auth) mounted under /api prefix so Kubernetes ingress reaches them. CORS wide open (allow_origins='*' from env) — fine for mobile clients.
seed_data_creation: Fresh TEST_mobport_<uuid>@example.com user registered per run; one TEST recipe saved to that user; one AI recipe image cached under /app/backend/generated/recipe-images/<md5>.png.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green for mobile-port endpoints. If the mobile UI reports 422 on save-recipe or chat, verify the client is sending session_id (chat) and the full RecipeCreate schema with cuisine_type field (save). Apple Sign In invalid-token verification works — real Apple identity tokens will only be testable on a physical iOS device with in.moodfood.app bundle id or via Expo Go (host.exp.Exponent audience). Gemini Nano Banana image generation is live and cached on disk; expect ~5-10s first call, instant on cache hit.
